settings.title: Organization Settings
settings.noAccess: You don't have access to this page
settings.name: Organization Name
settings.localeHint: Used for receipts, emails, and number formatting
settings.logoHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, or SVG. Max {size}MB.
settings.invoiceAnnualResetDesc: Reset receipt numbering at the start of each year
settings.sepaFormatDesc: ISO 20022 pain.008 — standard for all SEPA-zone banks
settings.genderOptionsDesc: Configure the gender options available in member forms. Each option needs a value key and labels in all languages.

providers.title: Payment Providers
providers.description: Configure payment provider credentials and settings

recurringBilling.title: Recurring billing
recurringBilling.enabledDesc: Automatically generate membership-fee receipts on the configured schedule
recurringBilling.dayDesc: Day (1–28) the billing runs. Quarterly and annual fees are only billed in the first month of their period.
recurringBilling.notificationEmailDesc: Optional address that receives a summary after each automatic run

paymentReminders.title: Payment reminders
paymentReminders.enabledDesc: Automatically email members about overdue receipts on the configured schedule
paymentReminders.daysAfterDueDesc: Days after the due date before the first reminder is sent
paymentReminders.maxCountDesc: Maximum number of reminders per receipt (1–10)

communications.title: Communications
communications.enabledDesc: Let admins send announcements to members by email and in-app.

memberCard.title: Digital Member Card
memberCard.enabledDesc: Give members a digital card with a QR code for check-in.
memberCard.assignNumbers: Assign numbers to members without one

sso.title: Single sign-on (SSO)
sso.description: Let members sign in with Google or Apple. Enter each provider's credentials and switch it on — no redeploy needed.
sso.enableHint: Enable once the credentials are saved.
sso.secretHint: Leave blank to keep the stored value; enter a new one to replace it.
sso.consoleHint: Paste the backend URL and each redirect URI into the Google / Apple developer console.
sso.encryptionKeyMissing: The server could not initialise its encryption key — check that the storage volume is writable. Secret fields cannot be saved until it is.
sso.encryptionKeyRequired: Could not save the secret: the server has no working encryption key.
sso.encryptionActive: Encryption active — secrets are stored encrypted with a server-managed key and are never shown here.
